title: A Categories cell's hover lists each cost range on its own line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with two ranges, $0.00 to $100.00 and from $100.01: tier A on Markup % 30 then Markup % 20.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Point at tier A's cell on category A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A's cell on category A's row reads "% markup".

Step 2:

  • The hover shows two lines.
  • The first line reads "$0.00 to $100.00: 30% markup".
  • The second line gives the range from $100.01 with 20% markup.
